title: HateRephrase: Zero- and Few-Shot Reduction of Hate Intensity in Online Posts using Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The ability of large language models to rephrase hateful online posts about Islam and Muslims to reduce their hate intensity while preserving the original semantic meaning.
findings: Large Language Models, particularly GPT-3.5, are effective at reducing the intensity of hate speech directed at Muslims. Human evaluations showed that GPT-3.5's rephrased outputs were often preferred over the original human-generated 'ground truth' rephrasings from the dataset. While open-source models like LLaMA-2-chat also performed the task, they were less consistent and sometimes failed by changing the meaning or even increasing the hate intensity of the original text.
